title: Profit and Loss (P&L) Statement
description: Management P&L contract for actual, budget, forecast, and variance performance by period or business unit.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: fs-profit-and-loss-statement
  title: Profit and Loss (P&L) Statement
  description: Management P&L contract for extracting actual, budget, forecast, and variance performance by reporting period or business unit.
  version: 1.0.0
  source:
    system: ladder
    sourceId: standard-financial-services/profit-and-loss-statement
    sourceVersion: 1.0.0
spec:
  documentType: profit_and_loss_statement
  sections:
    - id: report-identity
      title: Report identity
      fieldIds: [entity-name, business-unit, period-start-date, period-end-date, reporting-cadence, currency, scale, accounting-basis, scenario, comparative-scenario]
    - id: actual-results
      title: Actual results
      fieldIds: [revenue, cost-of-goods-sold, gross-profit, payroll-expense, sales-and-marketing-expense, research-and-development-expense, general-and-administrative-expense, other-operating-expense, total-operating-expenses, ebitda, depreciation-and-amortization, operating-profit, other-income-expense, profit-before-tax, income-tax-expense, net-profit]
    - id: plan-and-variance
      title: Plan and variance
      fieldIds: [budget-revenue, budget-operating-expenses, budget-ebitda, revenue-variance, operating-expense-variance, ebitda-variance, line-items]
  fields:
    - id: entity-name
      name: entity_name
      label: Entity name
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /report/entity_name
    - id: business-unit
      name: business_unit
      label: Business unit
      description: Department, segment, location, product, or consolidated scope.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /report/business_unit
    - id: period-start-date
      name: period_start_date
      label: Period start date
      dataType: date
      required: true
      sourcePath: /report/period_start_date
    - id: period-end-date
      name: period_end_date
      label: Period end date
      dataType: date
      required: true
      sourcePath: /report/period_end_date
    - id: reporting-cadence
      name: reporting_cadence
      label: Reporting cadence
      description: Monthly, quarterly, year-to-date, annual, or another stated cadence.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /report/reporting_cadence
    - id: currency
      name: currency
      label: Reporting currency
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /report/currency
    - id: scale
      name: scale
      label: Presentation scale
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /report/scale
    - id: accounting-basis
      name: accounting_basis
      label: Accounting basis
      description: Accrual, cash, management-adjusted, GAAP, IFRS, or another stated basis.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /report/accounting_basis
    - id: scenario
      name: scenario
      label: Primary scenario
      description: Actual, budget, forecast, or another scenario represented by the primary values.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /report/scenario
    - id: comparative-scenario
      name: comparative_scenario
      label: Comparative scenario
      description: Budget, forecast, prior period, or another comparison basis.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /report/comparative_scenario
    - id: revenue
      name: revenue
      label: Revenue
      dataType: number
      required: true
      sourcePath: /actual/revenue
    - id: cost-of-goods-sold
      name: cost_of_goods_sold
      label: Cost of goods sold
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /actual/cost_of_goods_sold
    - id: gross-profit
      name: gross_profit
      label: Gross profit
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /actual/gross_profit
    - id: payroll-expense
      name: payroll_expense
      label: Payroll expense
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /actual/payroll_expense
    - id: sales-and-marketing-expense
      name: sales_and_marketing_expense
      label: Sales and marketing expense
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /actual/sales_and_marketing_expense
    - id: research-and-development-expense
      name: research_and_development_expense
      label: Research and development expense
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /actual/research_and_development_expense
    - id: general-and-administrative-expense
      name: general_and_administrative_expense
      label: General and administrative expense
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /actual/general_and_administrative_expense
    - id: other-operating-expense
      name: other_operating_expense
      label: Other operating expense
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /actual/other_operating_expense
    - id: total-operating-expenses
      name: total_operating_expenses
      label: Total operating expenses
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /actual/total_operating_expenses
    - id: ebitda
      name: ebitda
      label: EBITDA
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /actual/ebitda
    - id: depreciation-and-amortization
      name: depreciation_and_amortization
      label: Depreciation and amortization
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /actual/depreciation_and_amortization
    - id: operating-profit
      name: operating_profit
      label: Operating profit
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /actual/operating_profit
    - id: other-income-expense
      name: other_income_expense
      label: Other income or expense
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /actual/other_income_expense
    - id: profit-before-tax
      name: profit_before_tax
      label: Profit before tax
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /actual/profit_before_tax
    - id: income-tax-expense
      name: income_tax_expense
      label: Income tax expense
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /actual/income_tax_expense
    - id: net-profit
      name: net_profit
      label: Net profit
      dataType: number
      required: true
      sourcePath: /actual/net_profit
    - id: budget-revenue
      name: budget_revenue
      label: Budget revenue
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /plan/budget_revenue
    - id: budget-operating-expenses
      name: budget_operating_expenses
      label: Budget operating expenses
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /plan/budget_operating_expenses
    - id: budget-ebitda
      name: budget_ebitda
      label: Budget EBITDA
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /plan/budget_ebitda
    - id: revenue-variance
      name: revenue_variance
      label: Revenue variance
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /variance/revenue_variance
    - id: operating-expense-variance
      name: operating_expense_variance
      label: Operating expense variance
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /variance/operating_expense_variance
    - id: ebitda-variance
      name: ebitda_variance
      label: EBITDA variance
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /variance/ebitda_variance
    - id: line-items
      name: line_items
      label: P&L line items
      description: Ordered line items with actual, comparison, variance, and source location when available.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /line_items
  validationRules:
    - id: entity-name-present
      severity: error
      description: The reporting entity is required.
      supported: true
      rule: { op: present, field: entity_name }
    - id: period-end-present
      severity: error
      description: The reporting period end date is required.
      supported: true
      rule: { op: present, field: period_end_date }
    - id: revenue-present
      severity: error
      description: Revenue is required for a P&L extraction.
      supported: true
      rule: { op: present, field: revenue }
    - id: net-profit-present
      severity: error
      description: Net profit is required for a P&L extraction.
      supported: true
      rule: { op: present, field: net_profit }
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.85
    fieldConfidence:
      period_end_date: { minConfidence: 0.95, reviewOnBreach: true }
      revenue: { minConfidence: 0.9, reviewOnBreach: true }
      total_operating_expenses: { minConfidence: 0.9, reviewOnBreach: true }
      ebitda: { minConfidence: 0.9, reviewOnBreach: true }
      net_profit: { minConfidence: 0.9, reviewOnBreach: true }
  outputSchema: {}
